chapterInfo.content:
65
Atemmuo ho nkɔmhyɛ
1 # Rom 10.20 Medaa me ho so metwɛn wɔn a wɔammisa m’akyiri kwan no;
na wɔn a wɔanhwehwɛ me no, metwɛnee sɛ anka wɔbɛhu me.
Mekaa sɛ: Menie, menie,
mekyerɛɛ ɔman a wammɔ me din no.
2 # Mmb 1.24; Yer 3.17 Mebaee me nsam daa nyinaa
mekyerɛɛ ɔman asobrakyefoɔ,
wɔn a wɔnam ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ so
di wɔn adwene akyiri no;
3ɔman a wɔyi me ahi
wɔ m’anim daa,
wɔbobɔ afɔdeɛ nturo mu,
na wɔhye nnuhwam ntaayaa soɔ;
4 # Yes 66.17; Lew 11.7 wɔtenatena adamena mu,
deda nkokoam anadwo,
wɔdi prakonam,
na akyiwadeɛ nkwan wɔ wɔn nkwansɛn mu.
5Wɔka sɛ: Twe wo ho,
nka me, na me ho te sene woɔ no.
Yeinom ne me hwene mu wisie,
ogya a ɛdɛre daa nyinaa.
6Hwɛ, wɔatwerɛ no wɔ m’anim:
Merenyɛ komm, na mɛtua so ka,
aane, mɛtua so ka agu wɔn kokom.
7Mɛka mo amumuyɛdeɛ ne mo agyanom amumuyɛdeɛ abom atua so ka,
AWURADE na ɔseɛ;
ɛfiri sɛ wɔahye aduhwam wɔ mmepɔ soɔ
na wɔasopa me wɔ nkokoɔ soɔ nti,
mɛsusu wɔn akane nneyɛɛ atua so ka.
8 # Gye 18.26; Yes 6.13 Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie:
Sɛdeɛ nsa ba bobe aba esia mu a wɔka sɛ: Nsɛe no,
na nhyira wɔ mu, no,
saa ara na me nkoa nti mɛyɛ,
na mansɛe wɔn nyinaa.
9Na mɛyi asefoɔ afiri Yakob mu,
ne me bepɔ sodifoɔ afiri Yuda mu,
na wɔn a mayi wɔn no bɛdi so,
na me nkoa atena hɔ.
10 # Yos 7.26 Na Saron bɛdane nnwankuo adidibea,
na Akor bonhwa no ayɛ anantwie dabea
ama me man a wɔhwehwɛ m’akyiri kwan no.
Ɔman waefoɔ no asotwe
11Na mo a mogya AWURADE
na mo werɛ firi me bepɔ kronkron no
na moto pono ma Siadeɛ bosom
na mohyɛ afrasa nkuruwa amama ma Hyɛberɛ bosom no,
12 # Yes 65.2; 66.4 me nso mede mo bɛma afena,
na wɔakum;
ɛfiri sɛ mefrɛe, na moannye so,
mekasae, na moantie,
na moyɛɛ deɛ ɛyɛ m’ani so bɔne,
na deɛ mempɛ na moyiiɛ.
13 # Yes 55.1 Enti sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie:
Hwɛ, me nkoa bɛdidi,
na mo deɛ, mobɛdi kɔm;
hwɛ, me nkoa bɛnom,
na mo deɛ, sukɔm bɛde mo;
hwɛ, me nkoa ani bɛgye,
na mo deɛ, mo ani bɛwu;
14hwɛ, me nkoa de akoma pa bɛto ahurisie dwom,
na mo deɛ, mode akoma mu yea bɛteam,
na mode honhom a abubuo asu yɔɔ.
15 # Yes 62.2 Na mobɛgya mo din de ayɛ ntanka ama wɔn a mayi wɔn,
na AWURADE Nyankopɔn bɛku mo,
na wato ne nkoa din foforɔ,
16 # Yes 19.18; Yer 4.2; 12.16 na ama deɛ ɔhyira ne ho asase no soɔ no
ahyira ne ho wɔ nokorɛdie Nyankopɔn mu;
na deɛ ɔka ntam wɔ asase no soɔ no
de nokorɛdie Nyankopɔn no aka ntam;
ɛfiri sɛ wɔn werɛ bɛfiri akane amanehunu no,
na ahunta afiri m’anim.
Ɔsoro foforɔ ne asase foforɔ
17 # Yes 66.22; 2 Pe 3.13; Adi 21.1 Na hwɛ, merebɔ ɔsoro foforɔ
ne asase foforɔ,
na wɔrenkae kane nnoɔma no
na ɛremma adwene mu bio;
18 # Yes 35.10 na mmom, momma mo ho nsɛpɛ mo na monni ahurisie daa daa,
adeɛ a merebɔ no nti;
na hwɛ, merebɔ Yerusalem ama no ayɛ ahurisidie,
ne ne man, ama no ayɛ ahosɛpɛ.
19 # Yes 25.8 Na mɛdi Yerusalem ho ahurisie,
na me ho asɛpɛ me me man ho,
na wɔrente esu
ne nteateam wɔ mu bio.
20 # Sak 8.4 Wɔrenhunu emu
abotafowa a ne nna nware bio,
anaa akɔkoraa a wanwie ne nna die;
na abɔfra bɛdi mfirinhyia ɔha ansa na wawu,
na ɔdebɔneyɛni a wadi mfeɛ ɔha no yɛ deɛ wadome no.
21 # Yes 62.8 Na wɔbɛsisi adan atena mu,
na wɔayeyɛ bobe nturo adi mu aba.
22 # Deut 28.30 Wɔrensisi adan mma obi ntena mu,
na wɔrennua mma obi nni,
na me man nna bɛware ayɛ sɛ dua nna,
na wɔn a mayi wɔn yi bɛdi wɔn nsa ano adwuma akyɛre.
23Wɔrenyɛ adwumayɛhunu,
na wɔrenwo mma mma mpatuwuo,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn a AWURADE ahyira wɔn no asefoɔ,
wɔne wɔn mma.
24 # Yes 30.19; 58.9 Na wɔnnya mfrɛeɛ no, mɛgye so;
wɔda so rekasa no, mɛtie.
25 # Yes 11.6-9 Pataku ne odwammaa bɛdidi faako,
na gyata awe wira sɛ nantwie;
na ɔwɔ deɛ, dɔteɛ na ɛbɛyɛ n’aduane;
wɔrempira, na wɔrensɛe adeɛ bio,
wɔ me bepɔ kronkron no nyinaa so,
AWURADE na ɔseɛ.

Medaa me ho so metwɛn wɔn a wɔammisa m’akyiri kwan no;
na wɔn a wɔanhwehwɛ me no, metwɛnee sɛ anka wɔbɛhu me.
Mekaa sɛ: Menie, menie,
mekyerɛɛ ɔman a wammɔ me din no.
Mebaee me nsam daa nyinaa
mekyerɛɛ ɔman asobrakyefoɔ,
wɔn a wɔnam ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ so
di wɔn adwene akyiri no;
ɔman a wɔyi me ahi
wɔ m’anim daa,
wɔbobɔ afɔdeɛ nturo mu,
na wɔhye nnuhwam ntaayaa soɔ;
wɔtenatena adamena mu,
deda nkokoam anadwo,
wɔdi prakonam,
na akyiwadeɛ nkwan wɔ wɔn nkwansɛn mu.
Wɔka sɛ: Twe wo ho,
nka me, na me ho te sene woɔ no.
Yeinom ne me hwene mu wisie,
ogya a ɛdɛre daa nyinaa.
Hwɛ, wɔatwerɛ no wɔ m’anim:
Merenyɛ komm, na mɛtua so ka,
aane, mɛtua so ka agu wɔn kokom.
Mɛka mo amumuyɛdeɛ ne mo agyanom amumuyɛdeɛ abom atua so ka,
AWURADE na ɔseɛ;
ɛfiri sɛ wɔahye aduhwam wɔ mmepɔ soɔ

Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie:
Sɛdeɛ nsa ba bobe aba esia mu a wɔka sɛ: Nsɛe no,
na nhyira wɔ mu, no,
saa ara na me nkoa nti mɛyɛ,
na mansɛe wɔn nyinaa.
Na mɛyi asefoɔ afiri Yakob mu,
ne me bepɔ sodifoɔ afiri Yuda mu,
na wɔn a mayi wɔn no bɛdi so,
na me nkoa atena hɔ.
Na Saron bɛdane nnwankuo adidibea,
na Akor bonhwa no ayɛ anantwie dabea
ama me man a wɔhwehwɛ m’akyiri kwan no.

Na mo a mogya AWURADE
na mo werɛ firi me bepɔ kronkron no
na moto pono ma Siadeɛ bosom
na mohyɛ afrasa nkuruwa amama ma Hyɛberɛ bosom no,
me nso mede mo bɛma afena,
na wɔakum;

mekasae, na moantie,
na moyɛɛ deɛ ɛyɛ m’ani so bɔne,
na deɛ mempɛ na moyiiɛ.

Enti sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie:
Hwɛ, me nkoa bɛdidi,
na mo deɛ, mobɛdi kɔm;
hwɛ, me nkoa bɛnom,
na mo deɛ, sukɔm bɛde mo;
hwɛ, me nkoa ani bɛgye,
na mo deɛ, mo ani bɛwu;
hwɛ, me nkoa de akoma pa bɛto ahurisie dwom,
na mo deɛ, mode akoma mu yea bɛteam,
na mode honhom a abubuo asu yɔɔ.
Na mobɛgya mo din de ayɛ ntanka ama wɔn a mayi wɔn,
na AWURADE Nyankopɔn bɛku mo,
na wato ne nkoa din foforɔ,
na ama deɛ ɔhyira ne ho asase no soɔ no
ahyira ne ho wɔ nokorɛdie Nyankopɔn mu;
na deɛ ɔka ntam wɔ asase no soɔ no
de nokorɛdie Nyankopɔn no aka ntam;
ɛfiri sɛ wɔn werɛ bɛfiri akane amanehunu no,
na ahunta afiri m’anim.


Na hwɛ, merebɔ ɔsoro foforɔ
ne asase foforɔ,
na wɔrenkae kane nnoɔma no
na ɛremma adwene mu bio;
na mmom, momma mo ho nsɛpɛ mo na monni ahurisie daa daa,
adeɛ a merebɔ no nti;
na hwɛ, merebɔ Yerusalem ama no ayɛ ahurisidie,
ne ne man, ama no ayɛ ahosɛpɛ.
Na mɛdi Yerusalem ho ahurisie,
na me ho asɛpɛ me me man ho,
na wɔrente esu
ne nteateam wɔ mu bio.
Wɔrenhunu emu
abotafowa a ne nna nware bio,
anaa akɔkoraa a wanwie ne nna die;
na abɔfra bɛdi mfirinhyia ɔha ansa na wawu,
na ɔdebɔneyɛni a wadi mfeɛ ɔha no yɛ deɛ wadome no.
Na wɔbɛsisi adan atena mu,
na wɔayeyɛ bobe nturo adi mu aba.
Wɔrensisi adan mma obi ntena mu,
na wɔrennua mma obi nni,
na me man nna bɛware ayɛ sɛ dua nna,
na wɔn a mayi wɔn yi bɛdi wɔn nsa ano adwuma akyɛre.
Wɔrenyɛ adwumayɛhunu,
na wɔrenwo mma mma mpatuwuo,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn a AWURADE ahyira wɔn no asefoɔ,
wɔne wɔn mma.
Na wɔnnya mfrɛeɛ no, mɛgye so;
wɔda so rekasa no, mɛtie.
Pataku ne odwammaa bɛdidi faako,

wɔrempira, na wɔrensɛe adeɛ bio,
wɔ me bepɔ kronkron no nyinaa so,
AWURADE na ɔseɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
